project.description: Packages the HPDS service and ETL images from the per-stack reactor lane; ships both tarballs to the stack's S3 prefix.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}" HPDS_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-hpds"
# Guard: reactor produces the service jar AND the ETL fat-jars # (assembly outputDirectory writes them into docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/). if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] \ || ! ls "$HPDS_DIR"/service/target/service-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1 \ || ! ls "$HPDS_DIR"/docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/*-jar-with-dependencies.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts for stack ${TARGET_STACK} -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt"
docker build --load -f "$HPDS_DIR/docker/pic-sure-hpds/Dockerfile" \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" "$HPDS_DIR" docker save "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > pic-sure-hpds.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-hpds.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-hpds.tar.gz"
docker build --load -f "$HPDS_DIR/docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/Dockerfile" \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-etl:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" "$HPDS_DIR" docker save "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-etl:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz"
